# netbox_config_template (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/extras/configtemplate/):

> Configuration templates can be used to render device configurations from context data. Templates are written in the Jinja2 language and can be associated with devices roles, platforms, and/or individual devices.

> Context data is made available to devices and/or virtual machines based on their relationships to other objects in NetBox. For example, context data can be associated only with devices assigned to a particular site, or only to virtual machines in a certain cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_config_template" "test" {
  name               = "test"
  description        = "test description"
  template_code      = "hostname {{ name }}"
  environment_params = jsonencode({ "name" = "my-hostname" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the config template.
- `template_code` (String) The template code of the config template.

### Optional

- `as_attachment` (Boolean) Download file as attachment.
- `auto_sync_enabled` (Boolean) Enable automatic synchronization of data when the data file is updated.
- `debug` (Boolean) Enable verbose error output when rendering this template. Not recommended for production use. Needs NetBox 4.6.0 or later.
- `description` (String) A description of the config template.
- `environment_params` (String) The environment params of the config template. Defaults to `{}`.
- `file_extension` (String) Extension to append to the rendered filename.
- `file_name` (String) Filename to give to the rendered export file.
- `mime_type` (String) Defaults to <code>text/plain; charset=utf-8</code>.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the config template. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_config_template.example 1
```
